title: Introductory data-science progressive assignment series
summary: Students complete four introductory data-science assignments with detailed dataset and column descriptions and progressive questions covering processing, visualization, statistics, and machine learning. Researchers tested raw prompts with ChatGPT, but the authentic student assessments do not report a student-facing AI role.

sources.title: Implications of ChatGPT for Data Science Education
sources.evidence_quote: We evaluated four assignments each from course 1 and course 3 and three assignments from course 2.

assessment.summary: Analyze supplied datasets through progressive questions on cleaning, transformation, visualization, statistical summary, and machine learning.
student_actions: Implement requested data-analysis or machine-learning steps.

student_role.description: Researchers benchmarked ChatGPT-3.5 on raw assignment prompts; student AI permission is not reported.

grading.method: Generated benchmark solutions were checked against the same tests and ground-truth outputs used for student submissions.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
